name: Católica Lisbon School of Business & Economics
summary: Private business school of the Catholic University in Lisbon; three bachelor's taught fully in English, applied to directly in rounds.

ib.text: Apply on predicted grades with IB Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL and a second listed exam, such as English or Business; below 14 of 20 overall gets no offer (2026 criteria).

lastYear.text: four rounds, 3 December–3 June; final grades by 17 July

programmes.name: International Undergraduate Program in Business Administration
programmes.about: Management taught exclusively in English with an analytic core: a common first year, then a management track and electives, and one or two exchange semesters in the third year (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, plus a second exam from the list (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

needs.note: The eligible maths exam; at least 50%, 80% recommended

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade, maths exam and a 15% profile (statement, CV, English, pitch video); below 14 of 20 gets no offer. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: International Undergraduate Program in Economics & Finance
programmes.about: Economics and finance taught exclusively in English: micro, macro and corporate finance after a common first year, with the last year open to exchange, the Tri-School programme or a double degree (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, plus a second exam from the list (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

needs.note: The eligible maths exam; at least 50%, 80% recommended

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade, maths exam and a 15% profile (statement, CV, English, pitch video); below 14 of 20 gets no offer. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: International Undergraduate Program in Management & Data Analytics
programmes.about: Management combined with data: programming, analytics, AI and machine learning alongside finance and marketing, then a data-analytics track with electives, exchange or a double degree (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL, plus a second exam from the list (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

needs.note: The eligible maths exam; at least 50%, 80% recommended

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on school grade, maths exam and a 15% profile (statement, CV, English, pitch video); below 14 of 20 gets no offer. 2026 criteria.

notes: Open to every nationality, EU citizens included: this is a direct application, not Portugal's national contest.
EU students at schools abroad need a Portuguese certificate of equivalence from the Direção-Geral da Educação; ask early.
Its Economia and Gestão degrees teach the first year in Portuguese, so they are not listed here.
